en.s: The Battle of Ruspina was fought on 4 January 46 BC in the Roman province of Africa, between the Republican forces of the Optimates and forces loyal to Julius Caesar. The Republican army was commanded by Titus Labienus, Caesar's former lieutenant during the Gallic Wars who had defected to the Republican side at the beginning of the civil war.

zh.s: 公元前46年1月4日，共和派贵族派军队与效忠尤利乌斯·恺撒的军队，在罗马阿非利加行省爆发鲁斯皮纳战役。共和派军队由提图斯·拉比埃努斯指挥。他曾在高卢战争中担任恺撒的副将，在内战开始时转投共和派。

en.s: The Battle of Ayn al-Warda (Arabic: مَعْرَكَة‌ عَيْن ٱلْوَرْدَة) was fought in early January 685 between the Umayyad army and the Penitents (Tawwabin). The Penitents were a group of pro-Alid Kufans led by Sulayman ibn Surad, a companion of Muhammad, who wished to atone for their failure to assist Husayn ibn Ali in his abortive uprising against the Umayyads in 680.

zh.s: 艾因瓦尔达战役（阿拉伯语：مَعْرَكَة‌ عَيْن ٱلْوَرْدَة）发生于685年1月初，交战双方为倭马亚军队与忏悔者军（Tawwabin）。忏悔者军由支持阿里家族的库法人组成，领袖苏莱曼·伊本·苏拉德是穆罕默德的圣门弟子。他们希望弥补自己在680年侯赛因·伊本·阿里反抗倭马亚王朝失败时，未能出手相助的过失。

en.s: The first Battle of Reading was a battle on 4 January 871 at Reading in what is now the English county of Berkshire. It was one of a series of battles, with honours to both sides, that took place following an invasion of the then kingdom of Wessex by an army of Danes led by Bagsecg and Halfdan Ragnarsson in an attempt to conquer Wessex. Both battle and campaign are described in the Anglo-Saxon Chronicle, and this account provides the earliest known written record of the existence of the town of Reading.

zh.s: 871年1月4日，第一次雷丁战役发生在今英格兰伯克郡的雷丁。此前，巴格塞格和哈夫丹·拉格纳尔松率领丹麦军队入侵威塞克斯王国，企图征服它；雷丁之战是随后双方各有胜负的一系列战斗之一。《盎格鲁-撒克逊编年史》记载了这场战斗及整个战役，也是目前已知最早提及雷丁镇的书面记录。

en.t: Battle of Reading: Æthelred of Wessex and his brother Alfred are defeated by a Danish invasion army
en.s: Æthelred I (alt. Aethelred, Ethelred; Old English: Æthel-ræd, lit. 'noble counsel'; 845/848 – Late April 871) was King of Wessex from 865 until his death in 871. He was the fourth of five sons of King Æthelwulf of Wessex, four of whom in turn became king. Æthelred succeeded his elder brother Æthelberht and was followed by his youngest brother, Alfred the Great.

zh.t: 雷丁战役：威塞克斯国王埃塞尔雷德及弟弟阿尔弗雷德被丹麦入侵军击败
zh.s: 埃塞尔雷德一世（古英语：Æthel-ræd，意为“高贵的谋略”；845或848年—871年4月下旬）自865年起担任威塞克斯国王，直至871年去世。他是威塞克斯国王埃塞尔伍尔夫五个儿子中的第四子，五兄弟中有四人先后成为国王。埃塞尔雷德继承哥哥埃塞尔伯特的王位，去世后由最小的弟弟阿尔弗雷德大帝继位。

en.s: The Spanish occupation of Jolo or Battle of Jolo was a military expedition in the 1630s to pacify the Moro of the Sulu Sultanate. The expedition, personally led by Sebastian de Corcuera, the then Governor-General of the Spanish East Indies was a follow-up expedition to the earlier successful campaigns against the Maguindanao Sultanate under Sultan Qudarat.

zh.s: 西班牙占领霍洛，又称霍洛战役，是17世纪30年代西班牙为镇压苏禄苏丹国摩洛人而发动的军事远征，由时任西属东印度总督塞瓦斯蒂安·德·科尔奎拉亲自率领。此前，西班牙已成功进攻由库达拉特苏丹统治的马京达瑙苏丹国，此次远征是后续行动。

en.t: English Civil War: King Charles I, accompanied by 400 soldiers, attempts to arrest five members of Parliament for treason, only to discover the men had been tipped off and fled
en.s: Charles I (19 November 1600 – 30 January 1649) was King of England, Scotland, and Ireland from 27 March 1625 until his execution in 1649. Charles was born into the House of Stuart as the second son of King James VI of Scotland. After his father inherited the English throne in 1603, he moved to England, where he spent much of the rest of his life.

zh.t: 英国内战：查理一世率400名士兵试图以叛国罪逮捕五名议员，却发现他们已获通报逃离
zh.s: 查理一世（1600年11月19日—1649年1月30日）自1625年3月27日起担任英格兰、苏格兰和爱尔兰国王，直至1649年被处决。他出身斯图亚特王室，是苏格兰国王詹姆斯六世的次子。1603年，父亲继承英格兰王位后，查理移居英格兰，并在那里度过了此后大部分人生。

en.t: English Civil War: The Rump Parliament votes to put Charles I on trial
en.s: The Rump Parliament was what remained of the Long Parliament after Pride's Purge on 6 December 1648, when Colonel Thomas Pride commanded his soldiers to exclude from the House of Commons those members who were against the Grandees' intention to try King Charles I for high treason. The Rump was dissolved by Oliver Cromwell in 1653 and replaced by the Barebone's Parliament.

zh.t: 英国内战：残缺议会投票决定审判查理一世
zh.s: 残缺议会是1648年12月6日普莱德清洗后长期议会的剩余部分。当时托马斯·普莱德上校率兵将反对军方高层以叛国罪审判查理一世的议员逐出下议院。1653年，奥利弗·克伦威尔解散残缺议会，以贝尔本议会取而代之。

en.s: The Kunicki's campaign was a major military expedition led by the Right-bank hetman Stefan Kunicki against the Ottoman-Tatar forces in the Right-bank Ukraine, Moldavia and neighbouring territories as a part of the ongoing Great Turkish War. The campaign began in September of 1683, soon after the Christian victory at the Battle of Vienna.

zh.s: 库尼茨基远征是大土耳其战争期间的一次重大军事远征，由右岸盖特曼斯特凡·库尼茨基率领，在右岸乌克兰、摩尔达维亚及邻近地区对抗奥斯曼—鞑靼军队。远征始于1683年9月，即基督教联军在维也纳战役中获胜后不久。

en.t: Most of London's Palace of Whitehall, the main residence of English monarchs since 1530, was destroyed by fire
en.s: The Palace of Whitehall – also spelled White Hall – at Westminster was the main residence of the English monarchs from 1530 until 1698, when most of its structures, with the notable exception of Inigo Jones's Banqueting House of 1622, were destroyed by fire. Henry VIII moved the royal residence to Whitehall after the old royal apartments at the nearby Palace of Westminster were themselves destroyed by fire.

zh.t: 自1530年起作为英国君主主要居所的伦敦白厅宫大部分毁于火灾
zh.s: 白厅宫位于威斯敏斯特，从1530年起一直是英格兰君主的主要居所，直到1698年大部分建筑毁于火灾。其中一个重要例外是伊尼戈·琼斯于1622年建成的国宴厅，得以保留下来。此前，附近威斯敏斯特宫的旧王室寝宫遭火灾焚毁，亨利八世因此将王室居所迁至白厅宫。

en.s: The action of 4 January 1781 was a minor battle of the American Revolutionary War. A French frigate division, departing Brest, met two British 74-gun ships of the line. The frigates tried to flee their stronger opponents, which gave chase. One of the frigates sacrificed herself to allow the others to escape.

zh.s: 1781年1月4日海战是美国独立战争期间的一场小规模战斗。一支从布雷斯特出发的法国护卫舰分队遭遇两艘装有74门火炮的英国战列舰。法国护卫舰试图摆脱火力更强的对手，英舰则展开追击。其中一艘法国护卫舰牺牲自身，使其余舰艇得以脱身。

en.s: The Battle of Catalán was fought between the Luso-Brazilian forces under the command of Luís Teles da Silva Caminha e Meneses, the Marquis of Alegrete, and the artiguistas commanded by Andrés Latorre in Arroyo Catalán, present-day Uruguay.

zh.s: 卡塔兰战役发生在今乌拉圭的卡塔兰溪一带。交战一方为阿莱格雷特侯爵路易斯·特莱斯·达席尔瓦·卡米尼亚·梅内塞斯指挥的葡萄牙—巴西军队，另一方为安德烈斯·拉托雷率领的阿蒂加斯派军队。

en.s: The 1830 Maryland gubernatorial election was held on January 4, 1830, in order to elect the governor of Maryland. Democratic nominee and former member of the Maryland House of Delegates Thomas King Carroll was elected by the Maryland General Assembly against incumbent National Republican governor Daniel Martin.

zh.s: 1830年1月4日，马里兰州举行州长选举。民主党候选人、前州众议员托马斯·金·卡罗尔经州议会选举，当选州长，击败国家共和党籍现任州长丹尼尔·马丁。

zh.s: 1836年1月4日，马里兰州举行州长选举。辉格党候选人、前州众议员托马斯·维齐因无人竞争，经州议会选举当选州长。

en.t: The first issue of the Swedish-languaged Saima newspaper founded by J. V. Snellman is published in Kuopio, Finland
en.s: Saima was a Swedish language weekly newspaper which was published in Kuopio, Finland in the 1840s. It was one of the first Swedish language newspapers in Finland. The paper adopted the libertarian theory of the press which would lead to its closure in 1846 soon after its start in 1844.

zh.t: J. V. 斯内尔曼创办的瑞典语报纸《塞马》在芬兰库奥皮奥出版创刊号
zh.s: 《塞马》（Saima）是19世纪40年代在芬兰库奥皮奥出版的一份瑞典语周报，也是芬兰最早的瑞典语报纸之一。该报奉行报刊自由主义理论，于1844年创刊，不久便因此在1846年被迫停刊。

en.s: The Battle of Kassa was a battle in the Hungarian Revolution of 1848, fought on 4 January 1849 between Austria and Hungarian Revolutionary Army during the Winter Campaign of the Hungarian War of independence of 1848-1849. The Austrians were led by Lieutenant General Franz Schlik, while the Hungarians were led by General Lázár Mészáros.

zh.s: 1849年1月4日，奥地利军队与匈牙利革命军在卡绍交战。这是1848—1849年匈牙利独立战争冬季战役的一部分。奥军由弗朗茨·施利克中将指挥，匈牙利军队则由拉扎尔·梅萨罗斯将军指挥。

en.t: The McDonald Islands are discovered by Captain William McDonald aboard the Samarang
en.s: The Territory of Heard Island and McDonald Islands is an Australian external territory in the southern Indian Ocean. Discovered in the mid-19th century, the territory is a group of sub-Antarctic volcanic islands that lie on the Kerguelen Plateau. It is about 4000 kilometres (2500 mi) south-west of the Australian mainland and 1700 kilometres (1100 mi) north of Antarctica.

zh.t: 威廉·麦克唐纳船长乘“萨马朗”号发现麦克唐纳群岛
zh.s: 赫德岛和麦克唐纳群岛领地是澳大利亚位于南印度洋的海外领地。这组亚南极火山岛位于凯尔盖朗海台，于19世纪中期被发现。它们距澳大利亚大陆西南方向约4,000公里（2,500英里），距南极洲以北约1,700公里（1,100英里）。

en.s: The Battle of Macao Fort was fought between British and Chinese forces in the Pearl River, Guangdong, China on 4 January 1857 during the Second Opium War. Macao Fort was located on an islet about 3 miles (4.8 kilometres) south of Canton (Guangzhou).

zh.s: 1857年1月4日，第二次鸦片战争期间，英军与清军在广东珠江上的澳门炮台交战。该炮台位于广州以南约3英里、即4.8公里的一座小岛上。

en.s: The 1862–63 United States Senate elections were held from January 4, 1862, to November 13, 1863. Regularly scheduled elections were held for 20 out of the 70 seats in the United States Senate, and special elections were held in Indiana, Illinois, Michigan, Missouri, New Jersey, Oregon, and Rhode Island. The Republican–Union coalition retained their majority despite an unfavorable national environment.

zh.s: 1862年1月4日至1863年11月13日，美国举行参议院选举。70个席位中的20席按期改选，印第安纳、伊利诺伊、密歇根、密苏里、新泽西、俄勒冈及罗得岛州还举行了特别选举。尽管全国政治环境对其不利，共和党与联邦派组成的联盟仍保住多数席位。

en.t: The New Apostolic Church, a Christian and chiliastic church, is established in Hamburg, Germany
en.s: The New Apostolic Church (NAC) is a Christian church of the Irvingian tradition. Its origins are in 1863, when some members of a newly formed group of apostles settled in Germany to freely continue its practices to teach and baptize. The split left the Catholic Apostolic Church on one side and the Hamburg congregation on the other. The church has existed since 1863 in Germany and since 1897 in the Netherlands.

zh.t: 信奉千禧年论的基督教会新使徒教会在德国汉堡成立
zh.s: 新使徒教会（NAC）是一个属于欧文派传统的基督教教会，起源于1863年。当时，一个新成立的使徒团体中部分成员定居德国，以自由延续其传教与施洗实践。这次分裂使天主使徒教会与汉堡会众分道扬镳。该教会自1863年起在德国活动，1897年起也在荷兰活动。

en.s: The Battle of Pecos River was fought in 1864 during the Navajo Wars. United States Army troops and Apache Scouts defeated a force of Navajo warriors next to the Pecos River in New Mexico. It is notable for being one of the many Indian war battles involving the California Column.

zh.s: 佩科斯河战役发生于1864年的纳瓦霍战争期间。美军与阿帕奇侦察兵在新墨西哥的佩科斯河畔击败了一支纳瓦霍战士部队。这也是加利福尼亚纵队参与的多场印第安战争战斗之一。

en.s: The Battle of Bagdad took place on 4 January 1866, in the town of Bagdad in Matamoros, Tamaulipas, Mexico, between the Mexican army of the Republic against the army of the Second French and Mexican Empire.

en.s: The Battle of Sofia (Bulgarian: Битката при София) was the culmination of Russian General Iosif Gurko's Western Squad for the defeat of the Orhaniye army in the Russo-Turkish War (1877–1878). It led to the liberation of Sofia from Turkish rule.

zh.s: 索非亚战役是1877年至1878年俄土战争期间，俄军约瑟夫·古尔科将军率西部支队击败奥尔哈尼耶军队的关键战斗，使索非亚摆脱了土耳其统治。

en.t: The Fabian Society is founded in London, United Kingdom
en.s: The Fabian Society () is a British socialist organisation whose purpose is to advance the principles of social democracy and democratic socialism via gradualist and reformist effort in democracies, rather than by revolutionary overthrow. It is related to radicalism, a left-wing liberal tradition. As one of the founding organisations of the Labour Representation Committee in 1900, and as an important influence upon the Labour Party which grew from it, the Fabian Society has strongly influenced British politics.

zh.t: 费边社在英国伦敦成立
zh.s: 费边社是英国社会主义组织，主张在民主制度内通过渐进改革，推进社会民主主义与民主社会主义，而非以革命推翻现有制度。它与左翼自由主义传统中的激进主义有关。费边社是1900年劳工代表委员会的创始组织之一，也深刻影响了由该委员会发展而来的工党，对英国政治产生了重要影响。

en.s: The Battle of Núi Bop (3–4 January 1885) was a French victory during the Sino-French War. The battle was fought to clear Chinese forces away from the French forward base at Chu, and was an essential preliminary to the Lạng Sơn Campaign in February 1885.

en.s: The January 1886 Calgary municipal election was held on January 4, 1886 to elect a Mayor and four Councillors to sit on the second Calgary Town Council from January 18, 1886 (or April 3, 1886) to October 21, 1886. The second Council was terminated by a special Territorial Ordinance effective October 21, 1886 following an order by local Stipendiary Magistrate Jeremiah Travis.

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Greece on 4 January 1887. Supporters of Charilaos Trikoupis emerged as the largest bloc in Parliament, with 90 of the 150 seats. Following the election Trikoupis remained Prime Minister, having assumed office on 21 May 1886.

zh.s: 1887年1月4日，希腊举行议会选举。哈里劳斯·特里库皮斯的支持者取得150席中的90席，成为议会最大阵营。特里库皮斯自1886年5月21日起担任首相，选后继续留任。

en.t: Topsy, an elephant, is electrocuted by the owners of Luna Park, Coney Island. The Edison film company records the film Electrocuting an Elephant of Topsy's death
en.s: Luna Park was an amusement park that operated in the Coney Island neighborhood of Brooklyn in New York City, United States, from 1903 to 1944. The park was located on a site bounded by Surf Avenue to the south, West 8th Street to the east, Neptune Avenue to the north, and West 12th Street to the west.

zh.t: 康尼岛月神公园的业主将大象托普西电死，爱迪生电影公司拍下《电死一头大象》
zh.s: 月神公园是一座位于美国纽约市布鲁克林康尼岛社区的游乐园，营业时间为1903年至1944年。园区南至冲浪大道，东至西第8街，北至海王星大道，西至西第12街。

en.s: The Imperial Trans-Antarctic Expedition (abbreviated as ITAE) of 1914–1917 is considered to be the last major expedition of the Heroic Age of Antarctic Exploration. Conceived by Sir Ernest Shackleton, the expedition was an attempt to make the first land crossing of the Antarctic continent. After Roald Amundsen's South Pole expedition in 1911, this crossing remained, in Shackleton's words, the "one great main object of Antarctic journeyings".
en.n: Explorer Aeneas Mackintosh of the Imperial Trans-Antarctic Expedition escaped death by fleeing across ice floes.

zh.n: 帝国横越南极远征队的探险者埃涅阿斯·麦金托什穿越浮冰脱险。

en.s: The Finnish Declaration of Independence (Finnish: Suomen itsenäisyysjulistus, Swedish: Finlands självständighetsförklaring) was adopted by the Parliament of Finland on 6 December 1917. en.s: On January 4–6, 1946, a small but violent tornado outbreak struck the South-Central United States, killing 47 people and injuring at least 412 others. L. H. Seamon with the US Weather Bureau, the predecessor of the National Weather Service, later stated it was the "most disastrous" tornado event of the year; the US Weather Bureau stated in 1960 that January 4, 1946 had "outstanding tornadoes".

zh.s: 1946年1月4日至6日，一轮规模较小却十分猛烈的龙卷风袭击美国中南部，造成47人死亡、至少412人受伤。美国气象局的L. H. 西蒙后来称，这是当年“灾难最严重”的龙卷风事件。美国气象局是国家气象局的前身；该机构在1960年也将1946年1月4日的龙卷风形容为“异常显著”。

en.s: The Third Battle of Seoul was a battle of the Korean War, which took place from December 31, 1950, to January 7, 1951, around the South Korean capital of Seoul. It is also known as the Chinese New Year's Offensive, the January–Fourth Retreat (Korean: 1·4 후퇴) or the Third Phase Campaign Western Sector (Chinese: 第三次战役西线; pinyin: Dì Sān Cì Zhàn Yì Xī Xiàn).

en.s: The National Radical Union (Greek: Ἐθνικὴ Ῥιζοσπαστικὴ Ἕνωσις (ΕΡΕ), Ethnikī́ Rizospastikī́ Énōsis (ERE)) was a Greek political party formed in 1956 by Konstantinos Karamanlis, mostly out of the Greek Rally party.

en.t: Sputnik 1, the first artificial Earth satellite, launched by the Soviet Union in 1957, falls to Earth from orbit
en.s: Sputnik 1 (, Russian: Спутник-1, Satellite 1), often referred to as simply Sputnik, was the first artificial Earth satellite. It was launched into an elliptical low Earth orbit by the Soviet Union on 4 October 1957 as part of the Soviet space program. It sent a radio signal back to Earth for three weeks before its three silver-zinc batteries became depleted.

zh.t: 苏联1957年发射的首颗人造地球卫星斯普特尼克1号离轨坠回地球
zh.s: 斯普特尼克1号（俄语：Спутник-1，意为“卫星1号”），常简称“斯普特尼克”，是首颗人造地球卫星。苏联于1957年10月4日将其发射至椭圆形近地轨道，这是苏联航天计划的一部分。卫星向地球发送了三周无线电信号，随后其三块银锌电池耗尽。

en.t: Luna 1 becomes the first spacecraft to reach the vicinity of the Moon
en.s: Luna 1, also known as Mechta (Russian: Мечта [mʲɪt͡ɕˈta], lit.: Dream), E-1 No.4 and First Lunar Rover, was the first spacecraft to reach the vicinity of Earth's Moon, the first spacecraft to leave Earth's orbit, and the first to be placed in heliocentric orbit. Luna 1 was launched as part of the Soviet Luna programme in 1959.

zh.t: 月球1号成为首个抵达月球附近的航天器
zh.s: 月球1号又称Mechta（俄语Мечта，意为“梦想”）、E-1 No.4及“First Lunar Rover”，是首个抵达地球卫星月球附近、首个离开地球轨道，也是首个进入日心轨道的航天器。苏联于1959年将其作为月球计划的一部分发射升空。

en.t: The Stockholm Convention (1960), to establish the EFTA, was signed on 4 January 1960 in the Swedish capital by seven countries (known as the "Outer Seven": Austria, Denmark, Norway, Portugal, Sweden, Switzerland and the United Kingdom)
en.s: The European Free Trade Association (EFTA) is a regional trade organisation and free trade area consisting of four European states: Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway and Switzerland. The organisation operates in parallel with the European Union (EU), and all four member states participate in the European single market and are part of the Schengen Area. They are not, however, party to the European Union Customs Union.

zh.s: 欧洲自由贸易联盟（EFTA）是由冰岛、列支敦士登、挪威和瑞士四个欧洲国家组成的区域贸易组织和自由贸易区。它与欧盟并行运作，四个成员国均参与欧洲单一市场，也都属于申根区，但并未加入欧盟关税同盟。

en.s: The Rupununi uprising was a secessionist insurrection in Guyana that began on 2 January 1969, led by cattle ranchers who sought to control 22,300 square miles (58,000 km2) of land. Occurring less than three years after Guyana's independence from the United Kingdom, it constituted the country's earliest and most severe test of statehood and social solidarity. The rebels were ultimately dispersed by the Guyana Defence Force, with the group's leaders fleeing to Venezuela.

en.s: The International Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Racial Discrimination (ICERD) is a United Nations convention. The Convention commits its members to the elimination of racial discrimination and the promotion of understanding among all races. The convention also requires its parties to criminalize hate speech and criminalize membership in racist organizations.

zh.t: 美国马里兰州蔡斯附近美铁列车与联合铁路机车相撞
zh.s: 1月4日，一列美国国家铁路客运公司（美铁）的客运列车，在马里兰州蔡斯附近与联合铁路公司的机车相撞，造成16人死亡。美国国家运输安全委员会的事故记录确认了日期、地点及涉事列车。

en.s: On 4 January 1989, two Grumman F-14A Tomcats of the United States Navy shot down two Libyan-operated Mikoyan-Gurevich MiG-23ML Flogger-G which the American aircrews believed were attempting to engage and attack them, as had happened eight years prior during the 1981 Gulf of Sidra incident. The engagement took place over the Mediterranean Sea, about 40 miles (64 km) north of Tobruk, Libya.

zh.s: 1989年1月4日，美国海军两架格鲁曼F-14A“雄猫”战斗机击落了利比亚使用的两架米高扬—古列维奇米格-23ML战斗机（北约代号“鞭笞者G”）。美方机组认为，对方正试图像八年前1981年锡德拉湾事件中那样接近并攻击他们。此次交战发生在地中海上空，距利比亚托布鲁克以北约40英里（64公里）。

en.s: The Sukkur rail disaster occurred on 4 January 1990 in the village of Sangi, near Sukkur in Sindh, Pakistan, claiming 307 lives. This makes it the deadliest rail accident in the country's history. The Bahauddin Zakaria Express, on an 800-kilometre (500 mi) overnight journey from Multan to Karachi, was significantly over capacity with far more passengers than its 1,408-seat limit. The train was meant to pass through Sangi, but misaligned rail points diverted it into a siding where it collided with a stationary 67-car freight train at a speed of at least 55 kilometres per hour (35 mph).

zh.t: 巴基斯坦苏库尔铁路惨案
zh.s: 1990年1月4日，巴基斯坦信德省苏库尔附近的桑吉村发生铁路事故，造成307人死亡，成为该国历史上死亡人数最多的铁路事故。巴哈乌丁·扎卡里亚快车当时正在从木尔坦前往卡拉奇，行程约800公里、需运行一夜。列车严重超载，乘客人数远超1,408个座位的容量。它原本应通过桑吉，却因道岔位置错误驶入侧线，以至少每小时55公里的速度撞上一列停着的67节车厢货运列车。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Lithuania in December 1997 and January 1998. Artūras Paulauskas finished first in the first round on 21 December 1997 with a significant margin, with Valdas Adamkus finishing second, but neither received a majority of the vote. Adamkus defeated Paulauskas in the runoff, held on 4 January 1998. With a vote difference of 0.74%, it is the closest result in the history of presidential elections in Lithuania since 1993.

zh.s: 立陶宛于1997年12月和1998年1月举行总统选举。在1997年12月21日的第一轮投票中，阿尔图拉斯·保劳斯卡斯以明显优势领先，瓦尔达斯·阿达姆库斯位列第二，但两人均未获得过半数选票。1998年1月4日举行第二轮投票，阿达姆库斯击败保劳斯卡斯。两人的得票率仅差0.74个百分点，是立陶宛自1993年以来历届总统选举中最接近的结果。

en.s: The nickname Fingerpoke of Doom (FPOD) refers to an infamous incident in American professional wrestling which occurred on January 4, 1999 at the Georgia Dome in Atlanta, Georgia, during a live broadcast of Nitro, the flagship show of World Championship Wrestling (WCW). The incident occurred during the main event of Nitro, featuring WCW World Heavyweight Champion Kevin Nash, who was the leader of the Wolfpac faction of the New World Order (nWo), and Hollywood Hogan, the leader of the Hollywood faction of the nWo, with whom Nash and his group had been feuding since April 1998 when the original faction split up, and Hogan had retired from wrestling.

zh.s: 1999年1月4日，美国佐治亚州亚特兰大的佐治亚穹顶体育馆，发生了后来被称为“毁灭一指”的著名职业摔角争议事件。当时世界冠军摔角联盟（WCW）的旗舰节目《Nitro》正在现场直播，压轴赛双方是WCW世界重量级冠军凯文·纳什与“好莱坞”霍根。纳什领导“新世界秩序”（nWo）的狼群派，霍根则领导好莱坞派。自最初的nWo于1998年4月分裂后，两派一直敌对；霍根当时也已宣布退出摔角比赛。

en.s: The Åsta accident was a railway accident that occurred at 13:12:25 on 4 January 2000 at Åsta in Åmot Municipality, Norway, south of Rena in Østerdalen.
